# Strategy to implement: [elite-path-relinking] Trajectory interpolation between incumbent and diverse el

Mechanism family: elite-path-relinking
Replacement scope: Insert a new post-processing phase after the existing SA block and before the final placement reconstruction in `compute_model_placement`; the SA result is preserved as fallback and as one endpoint of the relinking path.
Compute budget: ≤ 5 relinking trajectories × ≤ n steps each (each step one model reassignment, O(n+gpu_num) evaluation), so ≤ ~5n extra objective evaluations — bounded and small relative to the incumbent's 40000 SA iterations.
Gain mechanism: The incumbent explores by stochastic point moves around one current solution; it never systematically examines the region *between* two good solutions. Path relinking exploits the empirical fact that high-quality min-max placements often lie on trajectories connecting two elites: take the SA best assignment A and the target-greedy best assignment B (or, if identical, the second-best SA snapshot), define the differing model set D = {i : A[i] ≠ B[i]}, and walk from A toward B by reassigning one differing model at a time (order by largest weight req_rate/slo first), evaluating max-KVPR with the existing `objective` at every intermediate assignment.
